en.how_intro: HakiAI answers questions about Kenyan law using only the text of 25 Acts stored on this computer. It gives legal information, not legal advice.
en.how_step_1: It searches the 25 Acts for the sections that best match your question, both by meaning and by exact words.
en.how_step_2: It re-reads the closest matches and keeps the five most relevant sections. If your question is not about these laws, it says so instead of guessing.
en.how_step_3: A language model on this computer writes the answer from those five sections only, naming the Act and section for each point.
en.how_step_4: Every citation is checked against the five sections, and their full text is shown under Sources so you can check each claim.
en.how_covers_body: Only these 25 Acts, as they read in the copies stored here. Case law, county laws, regulations and later amendments are not included.
en.how_limit_1: Answers can still be wrong. The model may combine two sections wrongly or draw a conclusion that no section states. Check the sources.
en.how_limit_2: The citation check finds citations of sections that were not retrieved, but not a correct citation attached to a wrong statement.
en.how_limit_3: Answers are slow on an ordinary laptop, often several minutes, and only one answer is written at a time. Others wait in line.
en.how_limit_4: Kiswahili is machine-translated and is a best-effort aid. Legal meaning can be lost; the English legal terms are shown in brackets.
en.how_limit_5: It is not a lawyer. For decisions that matter, speak to an advocate or a legal aid provider.

sw.question_placeholder: Eleza tatizo lako la kisheria kwa Kiswahili au Kiingereza
sw.disclaimer: HakiAI inatoa taarifa za kisheria, si ushauri wa kisheria. Hakiki vyanzo vilivyotajwa na wasiliana na wakili aliyehitimu kabla ya kuchukua hatua.
sw.fallback: Siwezi kupata kifungu mahususi kinachoshughulikia suala hili katika mkusanyiko wa sheria uliopo. Tafadhali wasiliana na wakili aliyehitimu.
sw.translation_note: Jibu hili limetafsiriwa na mashine kutoka Kiingereza. Tafsiri inaweza kupoteza maana ya kisheria; maneno ya kisheria ya Kiingereza yameonyeshwa kwenye mabano.

sw.how_intro: HakiAI hujibu maswali kuhusu sheria za Kenya kwa kutumia maandishi ya Sheria 25 zilizohifadhiwa kwenye kompyuta hii pekee. Inatoa taarifa za kisheria, si ushauri wa kisheria.
sw.how_step_1: Hutafuta katika Sheria 25 vifungu vinavyolingana zaidi na swali lako, kwa maana na kwa maneno kamili.
sw.how_step_2: Husoma tena vifungu vilivyo karibu zaidi na kubakiza vitano vinavyohusika zaidi. Ikiwa swali lako halihusu sheria hizi, husema hivyo badala ya kubahatisha.
sw.how_step_3: Modeli ya lugha iliyo kwenye kompyuta hii huandika jibu kutokana na vifungu hivyo vitano pekee, ikitaja Sheria na kifungu kwa kila hoja.
sw.how_step_4: Kila rejeleo hukaguliwa dhidi ya vifungu hivyo vitano, na maandishi yao kamili huonyeshwa chini ya Vyanzo ili uweze kukagua kila dai.
sw.how_covers_body: Sheria hizi 25 pekee, kama zilivyo katika nakala zilizohifadhiwa hapa. Kesi zilizoamuliwa, sheria za kaunti, kanuni na marekebisho ya baadaye hayajajumuishwa.
sw.how_limit_1: Majibu bado yanaweza kuwa na makosa. Modeli inaweza kuchanganya vifungu viwili vibaya au kufikia hitimisho ambalo hakuna kifungu kinasema. Kagua vyanzo.
sw.how_limit_2: Ukaguzi wa marejeleo hupata marejeleo ya vifungu ambavyo havikupatikana, lakini si rejeleo sahihi lililoambatanishwa na kauli isiyo sahihi.
sw.how_limit_3: Majibu huchelewa kwenye kompyuta ya kawaida, mara nyingi dakika kadhaa, na jibu moja tu huandikwa kwa wakati mmoja. Mengine husubiri kwenye foleni.
sw.how_limit_4: Kiswahili kimetafsiriwa na mashine na ni msaada wa kadiri iwezekanavyo. Maana ya kisheria inaweza kupotea; maneno ya kisheria ya Kiingereza yanaonyeshwa kwenye mabano.
sw.how_limit_5: Si wakili. Kwa maamuzi muhimu, zungumza na wakili au mtoa msaada wa kisheria.
sw.how_privacy_body: Kila kitu huendeshwa kwenye kompyuta hii: swali lako halitumwi kwenye mtandao. HakiAI haihifadhi maswali wala majibu yako. Ni maoni ya hiari tu (ukadiriaji na maoni yako) yanayohifadhiwa.

sw.welcome_guest_note: Kama mgeni, hakuna kinachohifadhiwa baada ya kufunga dirisha hili.
